clearance_basis: Two 160-MU dry walkways flank a 64-MU, 16-deep channel. Each walkway exceeds three maximum player diameters (128 MU); level crossings and open gates provide 384 MU. Endpoint-cell and refuge routes use the same clearance. Existing supported player and prisoner collision sizes are unchanged.
gate_rule: Transparent barred rendering with native closed movement, Use, hitscan, projectile and AI-sight blocking. Accepted runtime sight blocking keeps the boss from alerting through the closed arena gate. Keys open permanently without consumption.
cardinal_spacing_basis: Author requested minimum-length hub approaches on 2026-10-02. Entry distance = half the junction grid span + room width + one collision-grid cell. Adjacent section floors retain exactly one 32-MU solid wall strip; no overlap or unintended connection.

return_network.basis: 128 MU width/headroom derives from four existing 32-MU grid cells and exceeds the accepted 74.7-MU maximum actor height. Lower ceiling -32 keeps one grid cell of solid slab under the upper floor. Water reuses the existing 16-MU harmless channel depth; no current or damage. Elevator uses the accepted MAP01 speed 16. Pits retain their 128x128 openings; no ladder or stair exit.
return_network.activation: Four independent permanent keyless grates: south/west/east/north, opened only from outside the lift enclosure below the upper slab. Use at either face then calls the platform from either landing; Use from inside sends it to the other landing.
return_network.progression_rule: Author approved on 2026-10-02: a closed block keeps all its trapdoor covers solid/inactive, including for enemies, until the normal keyed entrance opens. This prevents upward jumps through remotely opened pits. South is initially accessible.
return_network.save_policy: Author explicitly waived prior-save compatibility for issue #74 on 2026-10-02. New-layout mechanism state must persist through save/load and hub travel.
return_network.moving_sector_isolation: Lower paths avoid every surface gate and crusher panel. East branches detour around crusher 43923 so its original base floor and complete sector remain unchanged.
